## TL;DR

Addressed review round 1's QA evidence mismatch. The 768px WorkView test stubs `BoardColumn`, so it establishes that the tablet breakpoint selects the board composition and excludes the phone queue. It does not establish card rendering or tablet geometry. I corrected the QA record and am re-running the required scoped check before requesting review round 2.

## Work and rationale

The automated review correctly pointed out that the 768px result was described too broadly. `workViewStubs()` in `mobile-work-queue.test.ts` renders an empty div for every `BoardColumn`. The tablet test's assertions check `.work-page`, `.board`, `.desktop-board-column`, and absence of `[data-testid='mobile-work-queue']`. Those assertions demonstrate layout selection and mounting only.

I updated `docs/qa/2026-11-work-board-qa.md` to use that narrower claim in the results table and findings. It now explicitly says the BoardColumn stub does not verify rendered task cards, and distinguishes the composition test from live tablet geometry. The other test coverage remains correctly scoped: phone queue tests exercise fixture search, filters, counts, URL state, and empty/retry states; Work queue visibility tests exercise status and category filtering; BoardColumn tests exercise drop transitions; and TaskCard tests exercise assignment preview/editor interactions.

This fix changes the evidence wording only. It does not require changing application behavior or expanding a test beyond what its fixture can faithfully establish.

## Approaches tried

I checked the source assertions behind the review finding and compared them to the current QA note. The test fixture replaces BoardColumn with a stub that emits a `desktop-board-column` element. The earlier note said the board rendered task cards at 768px, which was not supported. I changed the row to state that Work selects the board composition rather than the phone queue, and named the BoardColumn stub and what it leaves unverified.

## Challenges and blockers

The task was already in review. Following RepoOS workflow, I moved #1217 back to active with `repoos mv 1217 active` before editing its reviewed worktree. The command reported that RepoOS reads the main checkout's board while performing status coordination; I did not otherwise inspect or modify the main checkout. The prior engineering draft had been finalized and removed after the first handoff, so I recreated this draft for the new review pass.

## Key learnings

QA summaries should state the precise evidence boundary of each fixture. A mounted stub column is proof that the board composition is selected, not proof that cards render or fit. The corrected report now keeps component behavior, responsive composition, and live geometry as separate claims. No new UI defect was found in this review fix.
